method: Native1920x1080 fixed-junction reference points manually reviewed, then optical-flow tracked independently from reference99 to each frame; forward-backward<1.5native pixels AND native visual identity/visibility review required; two manual frame100 floor junctions and six independently reviewed inner-left-bank top junctions replace failed reflection/stile tracking. Accepted camera resection only. No camera/source warp or plane constraint. Unconstrained per-corner triangulation and leave-bank-out source Sim3 fits.
